description: This file defines the DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and encapsulates filtering parameters (fromDate, toDate, empNumber) for searching timesheets in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to specify search filter parameters like date range and employee number for timesheet searches.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter used for searching timesheets.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter used for searching timesheets.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering.
